opening.argument: The presentation markets downloadable token-sniping software through a shop and checkout process, requiring payment before access: viewers are told they can “instant download it after you make the payment,” and are directed to “send this much amount of ethereum to this wallet address.” The software is described as matching token liquidity transactions and placing a buy order in the same block, a front-running operation that “can make you a big amount of profit.” Its description further promotes systems designed to avoid anti-bot controls. Although the description includes a risk disclosure and denies guaranteed outcomes, the evidence does not claim that the bot worked, that profit occurred, or that any purchase was completed.
